name: Courier
look: young man, motorbike courier, slim athletic build, dark hair, red open-face motorcycle helmet, black leather jacket with a reflective stripe, black gloves, dark riding trousers and boots
pose: riding low over the scooter, both hands on the grips; at the start he jumps onto it holding the luggage, bare-headed until he puts the helmet on at about 2.5 to 4.5 seconds; at the end he sits up and looks at the clock tower

name: Bike
look: glossy red scooter, black wheels and seat, a bright white headlight, a small black rear rack carrying the cash-filled luggage
pose: ridden fast; burns out, weaves, jumps the drawbridge gap, lands, then skids round 180 degrees to a stop on the helipad

name: Package
look: one piece of cash-filled hard-shell luggage, strapped to the scooter's rear rack with two black straps
pose: he holds it while he mounts the scooter, then it is strapped to the rear rack and stays there the whole time

name: SUV
look: large black SUV, gloss black paint, dark tinted windows, bright white headlights
pose: chasing the scooter; smashes through a fruit stall, then brakes hard and skids to a stop short of the raised bridge leaf, unable to follow (it never goes into the river)

name: SUV driver
look: heavy-set man in a black suit and black sunglasses, seen through the tinted windscreen
pose: both hands on the wheel, leaning forward; braces back when he brakes

name: Clock tower
look: tall pale stone clock tower on a large civic building, four big round white clock faces lit from inside with two black hands, reading 11:59 then 12:00
pose: at the end of the avenue in shot 1, straight beyond the helipad in shot 11; the minute hand clicks to 12 at 28.4 s

name: City
look: small night city at midnight: a narrow alley, a straight avenue with street lamps and light traffic, a street market with fruit stalls and coloured awnings, a river with a bascule drawbridge, a road tunnel with strip lights, a concrete ramp up to a rooftop helipad; a low warm light from the west early on, cool moonlight on the roof
